title: Invertibility of a pointed section cone restriction
statement: Let $S,T$ be schemes [def-pc-scheme], $s:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to S$ a geometric point with $\Omega$ algebraically closed, $g:T\to S$, $N:I\to (S_{\mathrm{et}})_s$ a small initial diagram of pointed etale neighbourhoods, and $c$ a compatible section cone [def-weil-pbc-pointed-etale-section-cone]. Let $y:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to T$ satisfy $g\circ y=s$, and suppose that for every $i$, the first projection of $c_i\circ y$ is the marked point of $N_i$. For an abelian etale sheaf $F$ on $S$ [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves], suppose the germ from sections of $g^{-1}F$ on the identity neighbourhood $(T,y)$ to its geometric stalk at $y$ [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks] is an isomorphism. Then every morphism $r:F_s\to\Gamma(T,g^{-1}F)$ satisfying the component restriction equations of $c$ is an isomorphism. Here inverse image and global sections are those of [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image] and [def-weil-pbc-global-sections-functor].

source.place: Tag 03Q9, theorem-higher-direct-images, germ restriction construction; Tag 03QO, lemma-vanishing-etale-cohomology-strictly-henselian, global germ comparison. The proof generalizes the existing pointed germ calculation.

proof.text: Apply [lem-weil-pbc-inverse-image-stalk-germ] to g and y. Transport along g composed with y equals s. For each N_i, the section and its compatibility with y give the pointed pullback neighbourhood in the germ formula: compare its two projections, using the section equation for the base projection. Naturality of the germ with respect to this section identifies component restriction followed by the terminal germ and the stalk comparison with the original germ.

Let r0 be the inverse stalk comparison, the inverse terminal germ, and inverse terminal-evaluation/global-sections comparison. Cancel the two invertible factors in the preceding equation to verify every restriction equation for r0. Uniqueness for [def-weil-pbc-pointed-etale-section-cone] identifies r with r0. Hence r is an isomorphism.

proof_origin.place: Tags 03Q9 and 03QO; model-independent form of the germ calculation in the existing strict-local proof

mathlib_searches.query: For a pointed etale section cone a restriction from the geometric stalk is an isomorphism if the sections preserve a point where global sections compute the stalk
A geometric stalk is computed by global sections if restriction along a compatible pointed etale section cone has invertible terminal germ

from.place: Germ restriction and strict-local identification in the final proof paragraph, generalized to an arbitrary compatible pointed section cone
